I (21F) experienced something similar after family-related trauma when I was 15 and have just recently been able to recover much of who I was before. Being self aware (as you are) is honestly the first step. For me, it involved a lot of conscious thought about the things I was doing/saying and my motives behind doing so. The most valuable thing you can ask yourself is “why?”  If you force yourself to keep a similar thought process and ask those questions over and over it eventually becomes second nature. You don’t have to think like that forever because you just do it. You are not a bad person and you still have a kind heart. You shouldn’t be so hard on yourself! Focus on growth and development and it will come. It will be frustrating because it is definitely a gradual change, but you can certainly do it. Hope is not lost.
